global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, creamy broth with tender chashu pork and crisp menma. A single nori sheet rests atop, all nestled in a light blue bowl on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, slightly reflective surface.
regions.bowl: Light blue ceramic ramen bowl with red geometric and Japanese character pattern on its rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu broth with noodles appears creamy, pale yellow, and slightly cloudy, with visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible white salt crystals and irregular edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice: pale pinkish-white, tender, curved, with visible fat marbling and slightly glistening surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, fibrous, and slightly curled with visible texture and natural ridges.
